pages.description: Xero, and optionally the mailboxes the agent reads and sends from.
pages.intro: Connect the Xero account that holds your client organisations: one connection covers every organisation it can see. A mailbox is optional. The intake mailbox lets the agent file emailed bills, statements and invoice requests; the sending mailbox lets it send reviewed emails to clients.
